answer: To defeat Sybil attacks, agents must lock stake in an ivory vault where repeated identities face superlinear cost scaling: registering n identities requires burning stake proportional to n squared. A fraudulent replica cannot merely echo genuine activity, as non-linear proof-of-work puzzles enforce economic friction, ensuring that cultivating each identity is as costly as unearthing a rare pearl. Attacker expense scales exponentially with swarm size.
